annotations.title: Choose the partition for this session

description: Bind this connection to one partition (an unbound connection searches every active partition): later `remember` calls without `partition` land there, and `recall`/`list_memories` without `partition_scope` search only there. Not persisted across connections. Accepts a name or "id:<ulid>"; "all" is invalid. Returns the bound partition.

partition.description: Partition name or "id:<ulid>"; "all" and "all_active" are invalid.
